waypoints.name: Goodell Creek Trailhead
waypoints.note: Approach via Goodell Creek Trail and climber's path into Terror Basin (~7.4 mi, +5800'), then cross the Terror Glacier to the base of Inspiration Peak's south face.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 east from I-5 about 60 miles to Newhalem. Just after crossing Goodell Creek, turn left onto the small road to the Goodell Creek campgrounds and follow it uphill to the Upper Goodell Creek Group Camp at about 600 ft; the trail starts just back down the road from the camp. Camping in Terror Basin needs a national park backcountry permit, picked up in person at the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center.

waypoints.name: Inspiration Peak
waypoints.note: Grade III 5.8 line following a ramp system, finishing through the 'Great Gash' near the top of the face.
waypoints.directions: Follow the trail's old roadbed about 4 miles, across two boulder washouts, to a fire-ring campsite 200 yards past the second; take the unsigned boot path right, steeply through forest to treeline near 5,000 ft, traverse to the 6,200 ft saddle near Glee Peak and drop to camp near 5,800 ft. Rope up, cross the Terror Glacier icefall to the buttress at the face's lower-left corner, and climb four pitches via the Great Gash to the summit.
